screening.reason: Exclusion 3: classification uses only structural MR images (individual-level morphological/structural covariance networks derived from T1-weighted images) aggregated across 17 ABIDE sites; no resting-state functional connectivity analysis is performed.

evidence_quotes: In this study, we proposed a self-attention deep learning framework based on the transformer model on structural MR images from the ABIDE consortium to classify ASD patients from normal controls and simultaneously identify the structural biomarkers.

In our work, the structural MR images we used were aggregated from all 17 international sites, which contain 518 ASD patients and 567 age-matched normal controls (ages 7–64 years, median 14.7 years across groups).
